result:
opy `robert-nvda.json` into the site. The page will need that file next to `index.json`, which is outside my write scope, so no test covers it.

One line per test function:
- `test_api_base_is_configured_not_hard_coded`: the API base comes from an empty `<meta name="coherence-api-base">`, with no hard-coded host or absolute fetch URL (§12).
- `test_post_requests_go_through_one_helper`: `apiPost` is the only POST; it uses `apiBase()` and a JSON body, and no other HTTP verbs appear (§12).
- `test_rule_buttons_stay_disabled_with_the_current_note_when_no_api`: `disabled` and « Affichage seulement » depend on `apiBase()`, the `data-action` buttons remain, and the renderer makes no request (§12 N3).
- `test_rule_buttons_are_bound_to_decide_rule`: the `[data-action]` buttons call `decideRule`, and only when an API is configured (§12 N3).
- `test_decide_rule_posts_the_decision_route_and_rerenders`: `decideRule` posts `/profiles/${profile_id}/parsed-rules/${index}/decision` with `approved`, re-renders, shows errors with `role=alert`, and sends no `limits` or `llm` (§12, inv. 2).
- `test_rejecting_never_sends_approval`: reject maps to `approved` false, never a hard-coded true (N3).
- `test_intent_form_has_the_editable_draft_fields`: `#intent-form` has ticker, target weight and funding kind/ticker/class/amount fields, all read from the intent, with the four funding kinds, no `readonly` or disabled inputs, and no typed digits (§4 B2, §3.6).
- `test_intent_form_prefills_nothing_the_user_did_not_state`: input values are slots, there is no `selected`, `checked` or `||` default, the funding kind starts empty and `required`, and no NVDA, ZST or `in_0001` is typed in the form (D10).
- `test_confirm_posts_the_intent_route_with_the_edited_values`: `confirmIntent` posts `/intents/${intent_id}/confirm` with the edited fields as numbers, makes no request without an API, takes the response as the new report, and shows errors (§12 B2).
- `test_intent_form_is_wired_into_the_page`: the form and `loadFlowB` are used, `loadFlowB` fetches `reports/robert-nvda.json` and not `index.json`, and the form gets `rep.intent` (D10C constraint).
- `test_index_listing_stays_the_four_flow_c_reviews`: `build_site.REPORTS` stays at the 4 flow C reviews without `robert-nvda` (frozen D10C oracle).
- `test_cone_overlays_current_and_proposed_when_the_report_has_both`: `cone()` draws `metrics_current`, and `metrics_proposed` only when present, with both cones' p5 and p95 on the axis (§12, §20.7).
- `test_cone_overlay_is_labelled_before_and_after`: the cone and projection text carry « Avant » and « Après », an `aria-label`, and no D10 vocabulary.
- `test_flow_b_report_gets_the_display_block_the_page_needs`: `loadFlowB` builds `rep.site` from `profile_card` and `limits`, then renders.
- `test_flow_b_report_carries_robert_in_0001_for_the_static_demo`: the preview report is flow B with intent `in_0001`, NVDA, 10 %, funding specific ZST.TO (§3.6).
- `test_flow_b_report_has_before_and_after_cones_on_one_grid`: both cones have the same keys and length, are ordered p5 to p95 at every step, and differ (§13).
- `test_flow_b_report_before_after_sides_follow_decisions_d2_d7`: Robert's current P5 at horizon is at or above the floor and the trade's is below it, so the verdict is incoherent (D2, D7).
- `test_flow_b_report_has_no_site_block_so_the_loader_builds_it`: the report has the fields `site` is built from and no `site` of its own.
- `test_page_passes_the_blocklist_apart_from_the_fixed_disclaimer`: no §9.3 blocklist phrase in the whole page, exempting the disclaimer and the Recherche refusal sentence (§9.3, D10).
- `test_new_ui_code_passes_the_blocklist_and_d10_vocabulary`: the new functions' strings pass the blocklist and contain no best/option/alternative/suggest/rank wording (D10).
- `test_flow_b_report_text_passes_the_blocklist`: the Flow B report's strings pass the blocklist apart from the disclaimer, and the printed text blocks have no option or alternative wording (§9.3, D10).
